card.name: Words picking one of a pair or side
card.fires_on: Words that pick out one member of a pair or one side, such as 'one' in 'any one muscle', 'other' person, right 'hand', or the start of 'asymmetry'. The next word is likely to contrast the sides.

card.plain: It marks spots where the text singles out one side or one of a pair, and where an asymmetry word would be unexpected next.
